requirement_text: The vendor must hold a current SOC 2 Type II report and make it available under NDA.
The platform must support SAML 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM user provisioning.
The vendor must maintain FedRAMP Moderate authorization for all hosting environments.
Customer data should be encrypted at rest using customer-managed encryption keys.
Describe your penetration testing cadence and the remediation timelines for critical findings.
Implementation must complete within 90 days of contract signature.
Describe your migration approach for historical shipment and order records.
Describe the sandbox environments available to customers for integration testing.
The vendor shall publish a public status page with historical uptime figures.
The platform must provide role-based access control including custom roles.
The platform should offer a documented REST API with webhook events for record changes.
Describe native integrations with SAP, Oracle, and NetSuite ERP systems.
The platform should give real-time inventory visibility across every warehouse location.
The platform should expose webhook events, immutable audit logs, and exportable configuration change history.
Describe mobile application availability for iOS and Android devices.
The vendor must provide 24x7 support with a one-hour response for severity one incidents.
Describe your customer success staffing model and quarterly business review cadence.
Pricing must be fixed for the initial three-year term.
Describe the volume discount tiers available above 500 licensed users.
